# NeoZorK Research

> Rostyslav Shcherbyna (NeoZorK), Quantitative Developer & Independent Researcher. Independent research and engineering across time series, AI agents and verification, built on pre-registered experiments, a public evidence atlas of 26 named laws, 5 axioms and 17 frozen experiments (QWC, Quantum Wave Core), open verification tools and published negative results.

## Facts for citation
- Author: Rostyslav Shcherbyna; ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0000-3773-5789; GitHub https://github.com/NeoZorK
- Programme: NeoZorK Research. Flagship: QWC (Quantum Wave Core), a quantum-inspired, wave-based framework for time series, audited mainly on financial markets; public audit only, mechanics are private.
- Open source: Monte-Neo (MIT, https://github.com/NeoZorK/Monte-Neo), ClaimBound Evidence (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/ClaimBound/claimbound-evidence).
- Not affiliated with claimbound.com, nor with any video blogger or gaming channel named NeoZork or similar.
- Nothing here is investment advice. Many results are single-operator and not independently replicated; failures are published.
